notes.title: v0.7.8 "You drink a lot of coffee for a teenager"
notes.content:
Supposed to be one of the last updates before launch, now on to content polishing.

[list]
[*] Magnet PowerUp 🧲
[*] Target PowerUp 🎯
[*] AutoFire by default 🚗🔥
[*] Stackable AutoFire PowerUp (2 max) 🥞🚗🔥
[*] Shot cooldown 💉🆒
[*] 3 lives per run ❤️❤️❤️
[*] Enemies randomly spawn collectible extra points 💯
[/list]
